identity_persons.description: An IA-MNS Person: the single internal identity that owns conversations, preferences, links, credentials, roles and grants, independent of the surface or method used to sign in.
identity_persons.lifecycle: Persons are never hard-deleted by the application; an owner disables them instead. Shared deployment requires an owner-approved retention policy (PH-09) before rollout.

id.description: Stable application principal UUID; issued as the access-token principal and conversation owner. Never derived from a provider identifier.

display_name.description: Person-editable display name; initially copied from the first verified provider profile or chosen at enrollment. Not an identity key.

status.description: active, disabled or merged. Disabled and merged Persons cannot authenticate and their sessions are revoked.

updated_at.description: Database-clock last profile or status change; informational, not an audit trail.

merged_into.description: Person that absorbed this one through a proof-based or owner-approved consolidation; links, local credential, grants and conversations moved there.

objects.identity_persons_display_name_idx: Bounded administrative listing ordered by name.
objects.identity_persons_merged_into_fkey: A merged Person points to an existing Person; never deleted while referenced.
objects.identity_persons_merge_check: Merged status and target exist together and a Person never merges into itself.

identity_external_identities.description: A link between a Person and one stable external account (PDT Connect identitySubject or Sankhya CODUSU) under a fixed issuer, created from a server-verified proof by the account holder or by an owner selecting the account in the Sankhya directory.
identity_external_identities.lifecycle: Removed explicitly by the Person (recent authentication, never the last sign-in method) or an owner, with an audit event. Cascades only if a Person were deleted, which the application never does.

id.description: Immutable link UUID used to address removal.

provider.description: pdt or sankhya; selects the connector that proved the identity.

issuer.description: Fixed provider installation identifier from server configuration (PDT_IDENTITY_ISSUER or SANKHYA_IDENTITY_ISSUER); never taken from browser input.

subject.description: Stable provider subject: PDT identitySubject UUID or Sankhya CODUSU. Never a name or e-mail.

label.description: Display snapshot of the provider account name at last verification; informational only.
label.nullMeaning: The provider supplied no display name.

linked_at.description: Database-clock instant the link was proven and created.

last_verified_at.description: Application-clock instant of the latest successful proof through this link.

email.description: Normalized e-mail reported by the provider for this account. Used only as a hint to ask for proof before provisioning a second Person; never as proof or merge criterion.

established_by.description: proof: the account holder proved the account to IA-MNS; directory: an owner selected and attested the account from the Sankhya directory, validated server-side.

linked_by.description: Owner who attested a directory link.
linked_by.nullMeaning: Established by the account holder's proof.

objects.identity_external_identities_subject_key: One external account maps to at most one Person; no silent duplication or merge.
objects.identity_external_identities_person_prov: A Person has at most one account per provider installation.
objects.identity_external_identities_established: Known establishment kinds; directory links name the attesting owner.

identity_local_credentials.description: Optional IA-MNS local sign-in: unique login, memory-hard password verifier, lockout state and encrypted TOTP secret for strong authentication.
identity_local_credentials.lifecycle: Replaced on password change or owner-issued reset; TOTP reset by the Person or an owner reset. Deleted only with the Person.

person_id.description: Owning Person; at most one local credential.

login.description: Normalized lowercase sign-in name; unique and not an e-mail requirement.

password_hash.description: scrypt verifier with parameters and salt; never returned or logged.

password_changed_at.description: Application-clock instant of the last password change.

failed_attempts.description: Consecutive failed password or second-factor attempts since the last success; drives temporary lockout.

locked_until.description: Application-clock end of a temporary lockout.

totp_enabled_at.description: Instant the second factor was confirmed with a valid code.

totp_last_step.description: Last accepted 30-second TOTP step; prevents code reuse.

objects.identity_local_credentials_totp_check: An enabled factor has a secret.

identity_recovery_codes.description: Single-use second-factor recovery codes, stored only as SHA-256 hashes of high-entropy values shown once.
identity_recovery_codes.lifecycle: Regenerated sets replace previous codes; used codes stay marked. Deleted with a TOTP reset or the Person.

identity_sessions.description: Authenticated continuity for a Person: method, surface, assurance and expiry. Direct-URL sessions hold a rotating refresh credential (hash only); embedded sessions have none and renew through a new host proof.
identity_sessions.lifecycle: Expire at idle or absolute limits; revoked on logout, Person disable, credential reset, refresh reuse, or explicit revocation. Expired rows are pruned by the application after 7 days.

id.description: Session UUID; carried as the access-token sid claim.

method.description: Proof used: local, pdt, sankhya, bootstrap or enrollment.

surface.description: Where the session started: direct, pdt or sankhya. Never used for authorization.

assurance.description: single or mfa; administrative operations require mfa.

refresh_hash.description: SHA-256 of the current refresh credential.
refresh_hash.nullMeaning: Embedded or revoked session without refresh.

previous_refresh_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous refresh credential; presenting it revokes the session as reuse.

auth_time.description: Instant of the latest primary or step-up authentication; drives recent-authentication checks.

last_seen_at.description: Application-clock last user activity reported by the browser (or sign-in); the inactivity deadline is derived from it.

idle_expires_at.description: Application-clock idle expiry, extended on refresh but never past expires_at.

refresh_rotated_at.description: When the refresh credential last rotated. A request presenting the immediately previous credential within a short grace window is a concurrent refresh of the same browser and receives an access token without rotation; later presentations are treated as reuse and revoke the session.

objects.identity_sessions_expiry_check: Idle expiry and authentication time cannot exceed the absolute expiry.
objects.identity_sessions_revocation_check: Revocation instant and reason exist together.
objects.identity_sessions_refresh_key: A refresh credential maps to one session.

identity_role_assignments.description: Internal IA-MNS roles assigned to a Person. owner is the principal administrator with full IA-MNS capability and administration, independent of Sankhya or PDT roles.
identity_role_assignments.lifecycle: Assigned by bootstrap or an existing owner with recent strong authentication; the last active owner cannot be removed. Every change is audited.

granted_by.description: Owner Person who assigned the role.
granted_by.nullMeaning: Assigned by the server-side bootstrap flow.

objects.identity_role_assignments_pkey: A role is assigned once per Person.

identity_capability_grants.description: Explicit capability permissions granted to a Person by an owner, united with group grants. External links alone grant no permission. A grant may be narrowed by data restrictions (identity_grant_restrictions); an explicit grant takes precedence over the provider policy for its permission. The language model never creates grants.
identity_capability_grants.lifecycle: Granted, restricted and revoked by owners with recent strong authentication; changes reach new access tokens within their 10-minute lifetime and agent turns at once. Audited.

permission.description: Registered source permission such as sales_sankhya:read; validated against the composed catalog. Capability permissions (sales:read, products:read) are derived and never stored.

granted_by.description: Owner Person who granted it or last changed its restrictions.
granted_by.nullMeaning: Granted by the server-side bootstrap flow.

granted_at.description: Database-clock instant of the grant or of its last restriction change.

objects.identity_capability_grants_pkey: A permission is granted once per Person.

identity_grant_restrictions.description: Data restrictions of a Person's explicit grant (ADR-0037): each row admits one value of one dimension. Values of a dimension are alternatives; every restricted dimension of the grant must match. A grant without rows admits every row of its source.
identity_grant_restrictions.lifecycle: Replaced together with its grant by owners with recent strong authentication; removed with the grant or the Person. Moved with the grant on consolidation. Audited with value counts.

permission.description: The restricted permission of the grant.

dimension.description: Restriction dimension the permission declares, such as company or store; enforced by the module that owns the data.

value.description: ERP record code admitted for the dimension (for example CODEMP or loja.id), validated against the source when saved.

label.description: Display label read from the ERP when saved (company, project, seller, buyer, store or classification name); may be a person's name. Never typed by the browser.

objects.identity_grant_restrictions_pkey: A value is admitted once per dimension of a grant.
objects.identity_grant_restrictions_grant_fkey: Restriction belongs to its grant and is removed with it.

identity_groups.description: Owner-managed groups of Persons (ADR-0037). Every member holds the group's grants, united with its own grants.
identity_groups.lifecycle: Created, renamed and deleted by owners with recent strong authentication; deleting a group removes its memberships and grants. Audited.

name.description: Display name chosen by an owner, for example Comercial Matriz.

name_key.description: Case-insensitive normalized name (NFKC, lower case) that makes names unique; written by the application.

description.description: Optional owner description of who belongs to the group.

version.description: Incremented by every change of name or description; updates apply only to the version the owner saw.

created_by.description: Owner (identity_persons.id) who created the group; attribution without a foreign key, the audit trail is authoritative.

updated_by.description: Owner (identity_persons.id) who made the last change.

updated_at.description: Database-clock instant of the last change.

objects.identity_groups_name_key: Group names are unique regardless of case.

identity_group_members.description: Membership of a Person in a group; the member holds the group's grants.
identity_group_members.lifecycle: Added and removed by owners with recent strong authentication; removed with the group or the Person, moved to the surviving Person on consolidation. Audited.

added_by.description: Owner (identity_persons.id) who added the member; attribution without a foreign key.

added_at.description: Database-clock instant the member was added.

objects.identity_group_members_pkey: A Person belongs to a group once.
objects.identity_group_members_person_idx: Groups of a Person when computing access.

identity_group_grants.description: Permissions an owner granted to a group, optionally narrowed by identity_group_grant_restrictions; every member holds them.
identity_group_grants.lifecycle: Granted, restricted and revoked by owners with recent strong authentication; removed with the group. Audited.

permission.description: Registered source permission such as sales_vrmaster:read; validated against the composed catalog.

granted_by.description: Owner (identity_persons.id) who granted it or last changed its restrictions.

granted_at.description: Database-clock instant of the grant or of its last restriction change.

objects.identity_group_grants_pkey: A permission is granted once per group.

identity_group_grant_restrictions.description: Data restrictions of a group grant, with the same meaning as identity_grant_restrictions.
identity_group_grant_restrictions.lifecycle: Replaced together with its grant by owners with recent strong authentication; removed with the grant or the group. Audited with value counts.

permission.description: The restricted permission of the grant.

dimension.description: Restriction dimension the permission declares, such as company or store; enforced by the module that owns the data.

value.description: ERP record code admitted for the dimension (for example CODEMP or loja.id), validated against the source when saved.

label.description: Display label read from the ERP when saved (company, project, seller, buyer, store or classification name); may be a person's name. Never typed by the browser.

objects.identity_group_grant_restrictions_pkey: A value is admitted once per dimension of a group grant.
objects.identity_group_grant_restrictions_grant_: Restriction belongs to its group grant and is removed with it.

identity_tickets.description: Short-lived single-use flow state addressed by the SHA-256 of a high-entropy secret: bootstrap, enrollment, reset and link invitations, pending second factor, pending TOTP setup, provisioning choice, profile consolidation, and pending PDT or Sankhya proofs (state, nonce, PKCE verifier).
identity_tickets.lifecycle: Consumed atomically once or expires (minutes; invitations up to 72 hours). Expired rows are pruned by the application after 7 days.

purpose.description: Flow kind; a ticket is only accepted by its own purpose.

token_hash.description: SHA-256 of the secret presented by the browser or callback.

person_id.nullMeaning: The flow is not yet bound to a Person (sign-in, bootstrap or provisioning).

payload.description: Allowlisted flow state such as intent, surface, PKCE verifier, nonce or a verified external identity awaiting a choice. Never passwords.

created_by.description: Owner Person who issued an invitation or reset.
created_by.nullMeaning: Created by the Person's own flow or the bootstrap command.

identity_used_assertions.description: Replay protection for host identity assertions: SHA-256 of each accepted assertion jti until it expires.
identity_used_assertions.lifecycle: Rows are pruned after their expiry.

expires_at.description: Assertion expiry; after it the jti cannot be replayed anyway.

identity_audit_events.description: Append-only audit of security-relevant identity events: sign-in outcomes, provisioning, link and unlink, credential and factor changes, role and grant changes, session revocation and bootstrap.
identity_audit_events.lifecycle: Append-only for the runtime role. Retention requires an owner-approved policy before shared deployment (PH-09).

target_person_id.nullMeaning: No Person resolved, for example a failed anonymous sign-in.

details.description: Allowlisted non-secret metadata such as provider, permission, role or reason codes. Never credentials, tokens or free text.

identity_security_policies.description: The single owner-administered authentication policy: session lifetime, inactivity timeout, recent-authentication windows, second-factor requirement and remembered browsers. Absent row means the built-in secure defaults.
identity_security_policies.lifecycle: One row, updated in place by owners with strong recent authentication; every change is recorded in identity_audit_events with previous and new values.

session_max_minutes.description: Longest a direct-URL session lasts from sign-in, whatever the activity.

idle_timeout_minutes.description: Longest a direct-URL session survives without user activity reported by the browser.

recent_auth_minutes.description: How long a sign-in or confirmation allows sensitive changes to the person's own account without confirming again.

admin_recent_auth_minutes.description: How long a strong sign-in or confirmation allows administrative changes without confirming again.

mfa_requirement.description: Who must use a second factor with IA-MNS passwords: everyone, administrators, or none (never applied in production).

remember_device_days.description: Days a browser that completed the second factor skips it at sign-in; 0 asks at every sign-in. Owners are remembered only while the second factor is optional, which production never allows.

updated_by.description: Owner who last changed the policy.

updated_at.description: Database-clock instant of the last change.

objects.identity_security_policies_updated_by_fk: The last editor is an existing Person.
objects.identity_security_policies_session_check: Session lifetime between one hour and 30 days.
objects.identity_security_policies_idle_check: Inactivity timeout between 15 minutes and 7 days, never longer than the session.
objects.identity_security_policies_recent_check: Account confirmation window between 5 minutes and 24 hours, never longer than the session.
objects.identity_security_policies_admin_recent_: Administrative confirmation window between 5 minutes and 4 hours.
objects.identity_security_policies_remember_chec: Remembered browsers last at most 90 days.

identity_trusted_devices.description: A browser that completed the second factor for a Person and asked to be remembered; its HttpOnly cookie holds a random token stored here only as SHA-256.
identity_trusted_devices.lifecycle: Valid while not revoked and younger than the policy's remember_device_days. Revoked by the Person, by password or second-factor changes, by an owner reset or disabling; expired rows are pruned.

person_id.description: Person whose second factor the browser completed.

token_hash.description: SHA-256 of the 256-bit browser token; the token itself is never stored.

created_at.description: When the second factor was completed on this browser.

last_used_at.description: Last sign-in that skipped the second factor with this browser.

revoked_at.description: When the browser stopped being remembered.
revoked_at.nullMeaning: Still remembered while within the policy period.

objects.identity_trusted_devices_token_key: Token lookup; one row per browser token.
objects.identity_trusted_devices_person_idx: Revocation of a Person's remembered browsers.

identity_whatsapp_links.description: The WhatsApp number that an owner linked to a Person: the only authorization of the WhatsApp channel. An external identity attribute of an existing Person, never a sign-in method; it grants no permission by itself.
identity_whatsapp_links.lifecycle: Created, changed and removed only by owners through administration with recent strong authentication, each change audited in identity_audit_events in the same transaction. A change or removal revokes the channel at once for every message not yet answered. Moved to the surviving Person on consolidation when that Person has none, otherwise removed. Removed with the Person.

person_id.description: Person that this number identifies on WhatsApp; one number per Person.

phone_number.description: E.164 digits of the number without the plus sign, as validated and normalized on entry.

legacy_identifier.description: Deterministic legacy WhatsApp identifier of a Brazilian mobile (the number without its ninth digit), under which WhatsApp may report the same account; part of the uniqueness rule.
legacy_identifier.nullMeaning: The number has no legacy form (not a Brazilian mobile, or a subscriber range where the legacy form would be ambiguous).

platform_user_id.description: WhatsApp business-scoped user identifier (BSUID) that Meta reported together with this exact number in a signature-verified message; later messages that omit the number match it, and a different identifier together with the number is refused as a conflict.
platform_user_id.nullMeaning: No verified message from this number has been received since the number was linked or changed.

version.description: Incremented by every change of the number; queued channel work records it and is refused when it no longer matches.

linked_by.description: Owner (identity_persons.id) who first linked a number; historical attribution without a foreign key, the audit trail is authoritative.

linked_at.description: When a number was first linked to the Person.

updated_by.description: Owner (identity_persons.id) who made the last change.

updated_at.description: When the number was last set.

confirmed_at.description: When a verified message from the current number was first accepted.
confirmed_at.nullMeaning: No message from the current number has been accepted yet.

objects.identity_whatsapp_links_phone_key: A number identifies at most one Person.
objects.identity_whatsapp_links_legacy_key: A legacy Brazilian identifier identifies at most one Person.
objects.identity_whatsapp_links_platform_user_ke: A WhatsApp user identifier identifies at most one Person.
objects.identity_whatsapp_links_phone_check: E.164 digits only (8 to 15, no leading zero).
objects.identity_whatsapp_links_legacy_check: Only the legacy form of a Brazilian mobile, different from the number itself.
objects.identity_whatsapp_links_platform_user_ch: Only the business-scoped user identifier format.

identity_provider_groups.description: Owner-selected default group for each external sign-in provider; no implicit permission policy.
identity_provider_groups.lifecycle: Two fixed rows seeded by migration. Owners update with recent strong authentication and optimistic version checks. Verified provider sign-in adds normal, audited membership; changing the selection does not remove existing memberships. A selected group cannot be deleted.

provider.description: External sign-in provider: pdt or sankhya.

group_id.description: Existing normal group joined after successful provider sign-in.
group_id.nullMeaning: No automatic membership for this provider.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version incremented on every selection change.

updated_by.description: Owner who selected the group; historical identity_persons identifier without a foreign key, retained through consolidation.
updated_by.nullMeaning: The selection has never been changed by an owner.

updated_at.description: When the selection was last changed, or initially seeded.

objects.identity_provider_groups_provider_check: Only the two supported external sign-in providers.
objects.identity_provider_groups_actor_check: A selected group must have an attributable selecting owner.
objects.identity_provider_groups_group_id_fkey: An owner must clear or replace a default before deleting its group.
